chunks: And from his sermon (peace be upon him) concerning the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), and [about] who is worthy of the Caliphate, and [about] the insignificance of the world.

key_terms.الْخِلَافَةِ: The Caliphateةِ (الْخِلَافَةِ) (Note: corrected to الْخِلَافَةِ in text, glossing as Caliphate/Succession)

ai.seo_question: What is the main theme of Imam Ali's sermon regarding the Caliphate and the world?
ai.summary: This title introduces a sermon where Imam Ali (AS) establishes the divine right and superior qualifications for leadership, contrasting the transient, humble nature of the worldly life (Dunya) with the eternal value of spiritual authority. It sets the stage for his argument that true Caliphate requires sagacity and divine appointment, a core tenet of Shia political theology.
